rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the astronomical object.

example.english: The observatory says there is a chance we will see a comet tonight.
example.traditional: 天文台話今晚有機會睇到彗星。
example.jyutping: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 gam1 maan5 jau5 gei1 wui6 tai2 dou2 seoi6 sing1

rows.note: A speaker uses this colloquial, image-based term when referring to a comet by its broom-like tail.

example.english: Look, that comet's tail is really long.
example.traditional: 你睇吓，嗰粒掃把星條尾幾長喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 go2 nap1 sou3 baa2 sing1 tiu4 mei5 gei2 coeng4 wo3
